sources.title: Construct validity in psychological tests
inspected_locators: Four Types of Validation; mathematical analysis; The Nomological Net; Implications of Negative Evidence
sources.summary: Construct interpretations require testable relations and scrutiny of adverse evidence.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Methodological framework, not validation of gratitude, a questionnaire or contemplative realization.

sources.title: The Importance of Falsification in Computational Cognitive Modeling
sources.role: Behavioral adequacy beyond relative model ranking
inspected_locators: Pages 425–426; model-selection guidelines and Box 2, pages 430–432
sources.summary: Relative comparison should be complemented by task discrimination, recovery and simulation-based assessment.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A winning model is not thereby adequate. The article's predictive terminology is not uniformly held-out prediction; inspected researcher-hosted journal copy, publisher access blocked.

sources.title: Philosophy and the practice of Bayesian statistics
sources.role: Model checking versus updating within a candidate family
sources.summary: Discrepancy checks can motivate revising a family rather than merely updating its parameters.
sources.evidence_ceiling: An argued statistical philosophy, not consensus or a criterion of Buddhist non-reification. Published online in 2012; cited issue year 2013.

sources.title: Equivalence Tests: A Practical Primer for t Tests, Correlations, and Meta-Analyses
sources.role: Distinguishing inconclusive contrasts from practical equivalence
inspected_locators: Publisher HTML: Testing for Equivalence; Figure 1; Setting Equivalence Bounds; Discussion
sources.summary: Practical equivalence requires justified bounds and a corresponding test, not nonsignificance alone.
sources.evidence_ceiling: No equivalence margin or TOST result is supplied for this project. Do not transfer simple-test interval rules to joint bootstrap rectangles without justification. Direct HTTP receipts are challenge pages; browsing reader supplied full text.

sources.title: The generalizability crisis
sources.role: Alignment of inferential targets, design and verbal generalization
inspected_locators: Target article sections 1–3.2 and 6.3.1; pages 1–5 and 10 of published treatment
sources.summary: Generalization targets include stimuli, tasks and settings as well as participants.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Target article only, not the accompanying commentaries. More simulations or random effects do not automatically validate constructs or extrapolation. Online 2020; cited issue year 2022.

sources.title: Beyond Reciprocity: Gratitude and Relationships in Everyday Life
sources.summary: Naturalistic gift-giving study relates perceived benefactor responsiveness, gratitude and later relationship ratings.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Abstract only; no causal mediation, population-wide effect or benefactor-free appreciation mechanism established here.

sources.title: Guiding the study of brain dynamics by using first-person data: Synchrony patterns correlate with ongoing conscious states during a simple visual task
sources.role: First-person descriptions as distinct empirical data
inspected_locators: Framework and Methods; early-edition PDF pages 1–2
sources.summary: Trained participants' reports defined experiential trial groups for behavioral and EEG analysis.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Task-specific method example; neither gratitude nor contemplative realization is validated. Inspected mirrored primary article; identity checked against NLM.

sources.title: Japji Sahib, in Sri Guru Granth Sahib
inspected_locators: Ang 1, pauri 2, final line; pauri 1 immediate context
sources.summary: Understanding divine Command is related to speaking without ego; Creator and grace remain explicit.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Not an explicit gratitude instruction, Bayesian self-model deletion, fatalistic inactivity or Buddhist emptiness; web edition undated.

sources.title: The Analects of Confucius (from the Chinese Classics)
sources.role: Reciprocal restraint as an ethical comparator
inspected_locators: Book XV, chapter XXIII, corresponding to Eno 15.24; digital release 2002-07-01, not translation date
sources.summary: A lifelong rule of reciprocity restrains imposition of unwanted treatment on another.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Does not specify gratitude or an emptiness doctrine; reciprocity is not a prerequisite of repayment. Preserve edition numbering discrepancy.

sources.title: The Analects of Confucius: An Online Teaching Translation
sources.summary: Institutional teaching translation identifies the reciprocity exchange as 15.24, corresponding to Legge XV.23.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Confirms passage identity and numbering, not a shared cross-tradition gratitude mechanism.

sources.title: Pirkei Avot
inspected_locators: 4:1, Ben Zoma on wealth; exact named version Mishnah Yomit by Dr. Joshua Kulp
sources.summary: Wealth is redescribed as rejoicing in one's lot, with labor and scriptural context retained.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Contentment is not automatically benefactor-directed gratitude, praise of deprivation or justification of injustice; undated named translation.

sources.title: The Clear Quran
inspected_locators: Surat Luqman 31:12; context 31:13; compare 14:7–8; translation distinguished from tafsir
sources.summary: Gratitude is directed to Allah, benefits the grateful person and does not supply a divine need.
sources.evidence_ceiling: The good is not quantified as wealth, mental health or predictive accuracy; divine independence is not impersonal absence. Web edition undated.

sources.title: Bhagavad Gita: The Song of God
sources.role: Received gifts, sacrificial offering and responsive obligation
inspected_locators: 3.10–13, four separately inspected Translation sections; distinguish commentary
sources.summary: Human and divine participants are related through sacrifice; enjoying gifts without return offerings is censured.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Yajña is not secular exchange or Bayesian reciprocity; theological promises are not experimental predictions. Web edition undated.

sources.title: Mulamadhyamakakarika
sources.role: Dependent arising, emptiness, designation and the two truths
inspected_locators: MMK 24.8–10 and 24.18; Sanskrit e-text, Douglas Bachman / Richard Mahoney; TEI conversion 2020-07-31
sources.summary: The manuscript authors' paraphrase links dependent arising, emptiness and dependent designation, while retaining convention in teaching the ultimate.
sources.evidence_ceiling: No English quotation certified; print-source field blank. Resolving pronouns and dependent designation involves interpretation. Conventional truth is not predictive accuracy.

sources.title: The Insight that Brings Us to the Other Shore
sources.role: Mahāyāna emptiness and contemporary translation choices
inspected_locators: First address to Sariputra; accompanying explanation of revised translation, September 2014
sources.summary: The body/emptiness formulation and explanation resist nihilistic interpretation while explicitly identifying contemporary translational revisions.
sources.evidence_ceiling: An identified interpretive rendering, not doctrinal consensus, an unmodified ancient Sanskrit witness or validation of a computational realization measure.

sources.title: Bhagavad Gita: The Song of God
sources.role: Action without entitlement to its fruits
inspected_locators: Chapter 2, verse 47, Translation; Sanskrit and word glosses distinguished from commentary
sources.summary: Relinquishes entitlement to the fruits of prescribed duty while rejecting attachment to inaction.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Duty-oriented theological text, not a definition of gratitude, Buddhist emptiness or statistical inference; web publication year not established.

sources.title: New Revised Standard Version Updated Edition
inspected_locators: 1 Thessalonians 5:18; authorized NRSVUE display and translation copyright
sources.summary: Thanksgiving in circumstances is expressly situated in God's will in Christ Jesus.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Does not establish that every harm is a benefit, an apophatic doctrine or any empirical gratitude effect. Year identifies translation copyright.

sources.title: The Clear Quran
sources.role: Islamic gratitude, divine address and accountability
inspected_locators: Surat Ibrahim 14:7, with surrounding verses 14:6–8; credited translation distinguished from tafsir
sources.summary: A divine proclamation joins a promise to gratitude with a warning about ingratitude, in a deliverance narrative.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Religious promise and accountability are not a quantified law of wealth, optimism, predictive accuracy or clinical efficacy; edition year not established.

sources.title: Mishnah Berakhot
sources.role: Jewish blessing across good and adverse circumstances
inspected_locators: Mishnah Berakhot 9:5, opening clause; named Joshua Kulp edition and version metadata
sources.summary: Requires blessing God for evil as for good; the distinction between circumstances remains meaningful.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Blessing is not interchangeable with gratitude or favorable evidence. A specific translation is admitted; no publication date or empirical effect inferred.

sources.title: Dionysius the Areopagite: On the Divine Names and the Mystical Theology
inspected_locators: Mystical Theology II and V; chapter V final sentence; electronic edition title page
sources.summary: Places the transcendent divine Cause beyond affirmation and negation; removal of predicates is related to praise.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Christian theological writing rather than biblical scripture; not the same object of negation as Madhyamaka. Translator notes are distinct; edition year not established.

sources.title: Berakhot
sources.role: Ordinary capacities and differentiated blessing formulas
inspected_locators: Babylonian Talmud Berakhot 60b:5 and 60b:7; William Davidson Edition – English and version metadata
sources.summary: Opening the eyes occasions a blessing; the discussion of good and bad tidings preserves distinct formulas.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Annotated English translation is distinguished from editorial expansion and from the Mishnah. No inference of a psychological effect or of identical blessing and gratitude constructs.

sources.title: On the Assessment of Monte Carlo Error in Simulation-Based Statistical Analyses
sources.role: simulation precision and Monte Carlo error
inspected_locators: Sections 2 and 2.1; section 3; sections 4 and 4.1-4.3; equations FD1 and FD14 in PMC HTML
sources.summary: Distinguishes finite-repetition Monte Carlo error from apparent running-mean stability and from finite bootstrap approximation; precision depends on the target and generating distribution.
sources.evidence_ceiling: No guarantee from a visual plateau or asymptotic sample-size scaling. Nested prefixes are correlated, and more replication of a fixed mechanism does not validate that mechanism.

sources.title: How to avoid a perfunctory sensitivity analysis
sources.role: crossed sensitivity and limits of local robustness
inspected_locators: Sections 2-3, printed pp.1509-1510; section 5.1, p.1511, Figure 2 and equations 1-2
sources.summary: Single-factor directions leave interactions untested; broader sensitivity claims require exploration beyond a baseline and a justified input domain.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A finite crossed grid is not a global variance decomposition, does not cover unexamined mechanisms, and does not establish plausible human parameter ranges.

sources.title: If Nothing Goes Wrong, Is Everything All Right? Interpreting Zero Numerators
inspected_locators: JAMA 249(13), printed pp.1743-1745; zero-numerator argument and confidence-limit calculation
sources.summary: An observed zero event count does not establish zero population probability; the relevant binomial limit depends on independent trials and a common event probability.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Dependent adaptive windows cannot be pooled as independent trials. A whole-trajectory event is a different target from the available exact conditional count-selection oracle; no human safety inference is made.

sources.title: Process evaluation of complex interventions: Medical Research Council guidance
sources.role: prospective process measurement and implementation distinctions
inspected_locators: MRC process evaluation framework: implementation, mechanisms of impact and context; Figure 1; Box 1, Analysis
sources.summary: The MRC framework separates implementation, mechanisms and context; fidelity, dose and reach describe implementation components, whose boundaries remain debated. Context can affect outcomes even with similar implementation.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Methodological guidance, not validation of this finite model or a human gratitude intervention. Activity and access are project operationalizations, not established human fidelity, dose or reach measures.

sources.title: Computational mechanisms of gratitude practice
sources.summary: Four-stage simulation protocol learns a valenced world model, measures baseline updating, rehearses positive observations, and reassesses updating; separate modified Yarbus proof of concept manipulates precision.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Full-text analysis of preprint v1 only; simulated optimism is not human well-being; trauma and unstable environments excluded. OSF metadata DOI field is null, so no unverified preprint DOI is assigned.

sources.title: Find, Remind, and Bind: The Functions of Gratitude in Everyday Relationships
sources.summary: Proposes the find-remind-and-bind account of gratitude as strengthening responsive relationships.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A relational theory, not evidence that selective precision alone constitutes gratitude.

sources.title: Affect-congruent attention modulates generalized reward expectations
sources.summary: Randomized affect induction after cue learning altered compound reward generalization. Computational and gaze measures partly converged, but gaze findings depended on probe type and looking-time normalization.
sources.evidence_ceiling: An affect-induction task, not gratitude training. Model attention weights and overt gaze are distinct operationalizations; discrepant measures and eye-tracking exclusions limit a simple transfer claim. Supplements/data/code were not reanalyzed.

sources.title: Gratitude Interventions: Effective Self-help? A Meta-analysis of the Impact on Symptoms of Depression and Anxiety
sources.summary: Reports small depression/anxiety effects and emphasizes comparator-dependent interpretation of gratitude interventions.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Publisher abstract inspected; no claim that gratitude substitutes for treatment or that a synthetic optimism shift reproduces these outcomes.

sources.title: Positive Psychology and Gratitude Interventions: A Randomized Clinical Trial
sources.summary: Full-text Methods, Results and Discussion distinguish gratitude lists from hassles and neutral-event lists. Positive affect differed at post-test; no assessed outcome differed from neutral events at follow-up. Analysis retained only participants responding at a post-baseline assessment.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A community online writing trial with substantial attrition and a positive-content neutral comparator; not evidence for an absence-based intervention, precision mediation, or clinical deployment.

sources.title: Thankful for the little things: A meta-analysis of gratitude interventions.
sources.summary: Reports comparator-dependent effects: psychological well-being did not outperform psychologically active comparison activities.
sources.evidence_ceiling: An aggregate intervention estimate does not identify precision as a mediator or prove individual benefit.

sources.title: Using Gratitude to Promote Positive Change: A Series of Meta-Analyses Investigating the Effectiveness of Gratitude Interventions
sources.summary: Publisher metadata verifies a series of meta-analyses of gratitude interventions. Retained as a relevant synthesis to consult alongside Davis and Cregg.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only inspected; no effect magnitude or detailed conclusion attributed to this record.

sources.title: Counting blessings versus burdens: An experimental investigation of gratitude and subjective well-being in daily life.
sources.summary: Publisher metadata verifies the experimental counting-blessings versus burdens study of gratitude and daily subjective well-being.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only inspected; not used for numerical estimates or participant-level claims.

sources.title: Computational Mechanisms of Gratitude Practice
sources.summary: Journal abstract describes three simulations: precision allocation, optimism assessment and an abstract Yarbus-inspired attention proof of concept.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Journal abstract only; detailed paragraph analysis belongs to the separately archived preprint v1, not an assumed identical journal full text.

sources.title: Active Inference: A Process Theory
sources.summary: Derives a process account of inference and action from variational free energy and illustrates simulated neuronal phenomena.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A process theory and face-valid simulations do not establish neural implementation of this gratitude model.

sources.title: Losing the rose tinted glasses: neural substrates of unbiased belief updating in depression
sources.summary: Reports differential good/bad-news updating and associated imaging signals in depressed and control groups.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Clinical-group association is not causal evidence that increasing optimism improves health; abstract inspected.

sources.title: Optimistic update bias holds firm: Three tests of robustness following Shah et al.
sources.summary: Argues that optimistic updating survives corrected analyses and disputes the parameter choices in Shah and colleagues.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A disputed methodological reply must be read beside the critique; it does not make every asymmetry estimator valid.

sources.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
sources.summary: Author-hosted primary full text inspected for expected-score propriety and reward orientation (p.359), categorical quadratic/logarithmic examples (p.363), and integrated evidence as sequential predictive scoring (p.372, Section 7.1, equations 50-53).
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted methodological reading, not an empirical validation of this model. Propriety concerns expected score; calibration and sharpness are distinct. Sequential evidence scoring does not make a calibration-batch family preference a guarantee of improved frozen-forecast assessment.

sources.title: The perception of silence
sources.summary: Silence-based auditory duration illusions motivate a perceptual account of contrastive silence within structured auditory contexts. The discussion treats absolute silence and analogies to other modalities as further questions.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Evidence about contrastive auditory silence, not every absence, missing sensor data, metaphysical nothingness or contemplative attainment. A working-channel interpretation is this project's methodological distinction, not a sensor-failure experiment in the article.

sources.title: A meta-analysis of the effectiveness of gratitude interventions on well-being across cultures
sources.summary: Preregistered synthesis reports small aggregate well-being gains, between-country heterogeneity and methodological moderators; examined moderators did not explain cultural variability.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted full-text reading, without reanalysis or supplement inspection. Positive-activity nonsignificance is not equivalence; country is a cultural proxy and the search is English-only. Adjacent moderator prose and Table 2 disagree about the omnibus control-type test; no omnibus claim is imported. No validation of this project's mechanism.
inspected_locators: Results: Moderator Analyses: Separate Models; Table 2
Discussion: country as a proxy for culture and limitations
Materials and Methods: Effect size and variance calculations

sources.title: A critical examination of the effectiveness of gratitude intervention on well-Being Outcomes: A within-person experimental daily diary approach
sources.summary: Institutional author abstract reports within-person effects of gratitude contemplation on several daily well-being measures.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Study-specific diary outcomes do not establish neural mechanisms or generalize automatically to unsafe settings.

sources.title: Gratitude Intervention Evokes Indebtedness: Moderated by Perceived Social Distance
sources.summary: An adolescent writing experiment distinguished significant-other and health gratitude from a no-writing control. Gratitude/appreciation reports differed, but the indebtedness omnibus test was p=.077 despite a reported significant selected pairwise contrast.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Single adolescent sample, unmatched writing exposure, and an observational social-distance moderator; do not state universal indebtedness causation or treat gratitude/appreciation word ratings as discriminant construct validation.

sources.title: Efficacy of an internet and app-based gratitude intervention in reducing repetitive negative thinking and mechanisms of change in the intervention's effect on anxiety and depression: Results from a randomized controlled trial
sources.summary: Reports a guided internet/app gratitude intervention reducing repetitive negative thinking relative to a wait list, with mediation analyses.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Wait-list comparison does not isolate gratitude from guidance, expectancy or activity; mediation is not a synthetic precision parameter.

sources.title: Deeply Felt Affect: The Emergence of Valence in Deep Active Inference
sources.summary: Presents a deep active inference model of valence and affective charge using a context-learning and reversal simulation.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Formal affect model with proposed empirical tests; not a measurement of subjective gratitude or a validated neural mechanism here.

sources.title: Is depression associated with reduced optimistic belief updating?
sources.summary: Reports an independent replication of depression-related differences for negative-event updating; positive-event findings were inconclusive.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Valence-specific and observational group evidence; no treatment effect follows.

sources.title: Being Thankful for What You Have: A Systematic Review of Evidence for the Effect of Gratitude on Life Satisfaction
sources.summary: The authors review gratitude and life satisfaction and find weak evidence for superiority over positive or psychologically active controls, while acknowledging restrictive inclusion and a single-researcher search.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Primary text of a review, not direct reinspection of all included trials or proof of no effect. Its life-satisfaction focus and search scope cannot overturn newer meta-analyses or resolve mechanism.

sources.title: It's a wonderful life: Mentally subtracting positive events improves people's affective states, contrary to their affective forecasts.
sources.summary: Four studies distinguish imagining the nonoccurrence of an existing positive event from recounting its occurrence; measured endpoints include affect and relationship satisfaction, with forecasts examined separately.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Mental subtraction of an existing benefit is distinct from detecting no harm or valuing a prevented harm. Brief self-report outcomes do not establish durable benefit, a precision mechanism, or unchanged beliefs. Studies 1-2 did not find significant condition differences on the direct event-gratitude item.

sources.title: Is gratitude a moral affect?
sources.summary: Conceptualizes gratitude as a moral barometer, motive and reinforcer associated with receiving another person's moral action.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A conceptual account; impersonal absence appreciation lacks the benefactor structure and should not be relabeled as the same construct without testing.

sources.title: Introducing a Bayesian model of selective attention based on active inference
sources.summary: A computational selective-attention account relates precision, task context and active sampling; it supplies model lineage for distinguishing information gain from observation preferences.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted full-text model reading, not empirical validation of gratitude-to-gaze transfer or the project's region partition. Published model code and participant data were not independently reproduced.
inspected_locators: Selective attention model and active inference sections

sources.title: Comparing daily physiological and psychological benefits of gratitude and optimism using a digital platform.
sources.summary: Ecological momentary assessment reports overlapping but distinguishable associations of trait gratitude and optimism with daily experiences and physiology.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Observational associations; not an intervention trial and not evidence that the two constructs are interchangeable.

sources.title: Inference and missing data
sources.summary: Publisher metadata verifies the foundational inference-and-missing-data article.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; the project uses an explicit missing-observation symbol and does not assert an unverified ignorability theorem.

sources.title: Active Inference: Demystified and Compared
sources.summary: Compares discrete-state active inference and reinforcement learning, including preference learning and uncertainty-sensitive exploration.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Demonstrations in specified computational tasks, not superiority for psychological interventions.

sources.title: Opponent appetitive-aversive neural processes underlie predictive learning of pain relief
sources.summary: Reports conditioning of expectations of pain relief and reward-like/opponent neural learning signals during experimental pain.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Termination of pain is a measured human relief paradigm; a finite avoided-harm utility contrast does not reproduce its neural or subjective outcomes.

sources.title: Regret and its avoidance: a neuroimaging study of choice behavior
sources.summary: Reports regret induced by information about an unchosen gamble and changing subsequent choice behavior.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Regret and counterfactual feedback provide a comparator paradigm, not direct evidence about gratitude or non-reification.

sources.title: A pessimistic view of optimistic belief updating
sources.summary: Uses task analyses, simulations and experiments to argue that apparent optimistic updating can reflect statistical artifacts; emphasizes normative Bayesian comparisons.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Retain the competing Garrett reply; the critique motivates null-calibrated estimators rather than settling all optimism research.

sources.title: The optimism bias
sources.summary: Publisher metadata verifies the optimism-bias overview used in the source preprint.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; cannot justify treating optimism as a validated well-being outcome.

sources.title: A step-by-step tutorial on active inference and its application to empirical data
sources.summary: Tutorial provides discrete POMDP construction, simulation, fitting and mathematical implementation guidance.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Abstract inspected; specific Dirichlet-count choices in this project require explicit model declarations and independent numerical controls.

sources.title: Effects of the Gratitude Letter and Positive Attention Bias Modification on Attentional Deployment and Emotional States
sources.summary: Publisher metadata verifies a study comparing gratitude-letter and positive-attention-bias modification effects on attention and emotion.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; no unsupported direction, effect size or mediation claim extracted from the title.

sources.title: Modifying interpretation bias leads to congruent changes in gratitude
sources.summary: Publisher metadata verifies an experimental article concerning interpretation-bias modification and gratitude.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; an effect described in a title is not a validated mechanistic bridge for this model.

sources.title: Gratitude and well-being: A review and theoretical integration
sources.summary: Integrates interpersonal gratitude with habitual appreciation of positive life aspects and critically discusses intervention limitations.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Review-level conceptual framing, not direct proof of precision learning or efficacy of an impersonal absence practice.

sources.title: Decomposing Gratitude: Representation and Integration of Cognitive Antecedents of Gratitude in the Brain
sources.summary: Reports independently manipulating benefactor cost and recipient pain reduction with fMRI and reciprocal giving.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Abstract-level human social task; distinguishing benefit from benefactor cost matters, but no corresponding neural or interpersonal variables are measured in the finite simulation.

sources.title: The Fundamental Wisdom of the Middle Way: Nāgārjuna’s Mūlamadhyamakakārikā
sources.summary: Translation and commentary by Jay L. Garfield on Nāgārjuna; publisher title and bibliographic identity verified.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Publisher metadata only; no verse-level quotation or claimed full-text exegesis. The erroneous publisher landing-page abstract is not used. Philosophical reading does not validate a neural or clinical model.

sources.title: Empty Words: Buddhist Philosophy and Cross-Cultural Interpretation
sources.summary: Publisher synopsis identifies essays on Madhyamaka, Yogacara, Buddhist ethics and cross-cultural interpretation.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Synopsis only; motivates interpretive caution, not doctrinal equivalence between Bayesian models and Buddhist philosophy.

sources.title: Kaccayanagotta Sutta: To Kaccayana Gotta (on Right View), SN 12.15
sources.summary: Translation contrasts attachment to existence/non-existence with dependent origination and cessation; supplies a textual reason not to equate the project title with a doctrine that nothing exists.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Historical religious text in translation, not experimental evidence; no equivalence to active inference, gratitude efficacy or realization follows.

sources.title: Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife
inspected_locators: Section 2, printed pages 3-4: resampling steps 1-3, equations 2.4-2.8 and calculation methods
sources.summary: The inspected article scan defines independent empirical resampling with replacement and gives its conditional Bernoulli example; direct calculation and Monte Carlo approximation are distinguished.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted passages support the resampling construction, not universal finite-sample coverage. The strict-failure Bernoulli availability formula is an independent project derivation.

sources.title: A Simple Sequentially Rejective Multiple Test Procedure
sources.summary: The primary JSTOR issue table of contents identifies Holm's article in Scandinavian Journal of Statistics 6(2), pages 65-70. The project independently implements and tests its multiple-testing adjustment.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Indexed primary issue metadata inspected; article full text not read. Candidate DOI 10.2307/4615733 returned Crossref 404, so DOI is left unset rather than asserting registration. Direct article HTML was an interstitial, not article evidence.

sources.title: THE USE OF CONFIDENCE OR FIDUCIAL LIMITS ILLUSTRATED IN THE CASE OF THE BINOMIAL
sources.summary: Publisher-deposited metadata identifies a methods article on binomial confidence/fiducial limits.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; the repository independently computes exact binomial intervals and checks its numerical implementation.

sources.title: THE GENERALIZATION OF ‘STUDENT'S’ PROBLEM WHEN SEVERAL DIFFERENT POPULATION VARLANCES ARE INVOLVED
sources.summary: Publisher-deposited metadata identifies the generalization of Student inference with differing population variances.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; not evidence that the project-specific stratified analytic interval achieves its nominal coverage. Crossref title spelling VARLANCES is retained.

sources.title: An Approximate Distribution of Estimates of Variance Components
sources.summary: Publisher metadata identifies the article on approximate distributions of variance-component estimates.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; the project-specific effective degrees of freedom and operating characteristics require independent numerical checks. Supplied DOI 10.2307/3002022 was rejected because it identifies Mood and Snedecor, not this article.

sources.title: Permutation P-values Should Never Be Zero: Calculating Exact P-values When Permutations Are Randomly Drawn
sources.summary: The deposited abstract warns that naive randomly sampled permutation p-values may be understated and discusses a discrete-null computation strategy, particularly relevant with multiple tests.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Publisher-deposited abstract inspected; no full-text derivation claimed. The project separately declares its plus-one convention, sign-flip assumptions and Monte Carlo intervals.

sources.title: Using simulation studies to evaluate statistical methods
sources.summary: ADEMP separates generating mechanisms, estimands, analysis methods and performance measures; method comparisons require compatible targets and Monte Carlo uncertainty. Failure handling changes what performance is estimated.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A simulation-methods tutorial, not certification of this implementation or human-trial power. Fixed-world averages, within-world contrasts and alternative weighting schemes are different declared targets.

sources.title: VERIFICATION OF FORECASTS EXPRESSED IN TERMS OF PROBABILITY
sources.summary: Publisher-deposited metadata identifies the original article on verifying probability forecasts.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Metadata only; no abstract available in the inspected publisher record and no full-text reading claimed. This project explicitly defines its one-component binary Brier convention.

sources.title: How to check a simulation study
sources.summary: Recommends known-answer scenarios, staged generator checks, reproducible problematic datasets, and investigation of failures, outliers and coverage before changing a method.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Methods guidance does not validate any repository result. A fallback procedure changes the evaluated method; failures and excluded replications require explicit accounting.
sources.date_note: Online 2023-10-13; issue date 2024-02-01; key/year use issue year.

sources.title: Theoretical Comparison of Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
sources.summary: The deposited abstract compares bootstrap interval families and highlights percentile-t and accelerated bias correction under its theoretical comparison.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Publisher-deposited abstract and metadata only. Publisher HTML was a bot challenge, not full text. No theorem assumptions or finite-sample coverage guarantee are inferred for the project.

sources.title: Cula-suññata Sutta: The Lesser Discourse on Emptiness (MN 121)
sources.role: absence, residual presence and contemplative context
sources.summary: The translation distinguishes what is absent from what remains, moves through successive contemplative perceptions, and identifies even theme-less concentration as fashioned and impermanent.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Named English translation only; copyright 1997, Access to Insight revision 2013-11-30. No Pali collation, modern translation comparison, Madhyamaka identity, or empirical attainment validation.

sources.title: Nonparametric Bootstrap Confidence Intervals (boot.ci)
sources.summary: The boot.ci manual requires variance estimates for the original statistic and bootstrap replicates for studentized intervals and warns about extreme order-statistic endpoints.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Official manual snapshot for boot 1.3-32, retrieved 2026-10-15; 2026 denotes retrieval, not a claimed publication date. R code examples were read, not executed. The manual does not certify the project Python implementation.

sources.role: costly social motivation and affect comparator
sources.summary: Interpersonally induced gratitude increased costly helping relative to neutral/amusement conditions; source attribution constrained incidental helping of strangers.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Laboratory helping, not contemplative inquiry, benefactor-free appreciation or emptiness; mediation does not eliminate all rival explanations.

sources.title: Reconstructing and deconstructing the self: cognitive mechanisms in meditation practice
sources.summary: Proposes attentional, constructive and deconstructive practice families, separating meta-awareness, reappraisal and self-inquiry while retaining ethical, interpersonal and cultural context.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A framework with acknowledged empirical gaps, not evidence that gratitude causes insight; constructive preparation is our proposed mapping.
inspected_locators: Constructive Family: Perspective Taking and Reappraisal
Boxes 1-2; Concluding Remarks and Future Directions

sources.title: Towards a computational phenomenology of mental action: modelling meta-awareness and attentional control with deep parametric active inference
sources.summary: A simulated hierarchy separates perceptual, attentional and meta-awareness levels and access to cognitive states from their control; empirical fitting remains future work.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Our binary gate is simpler and does not implement or validate the three-level architecture. Opacity and access do not by themselves establish realization. Publisher correction niab035 assigns issue 1.
inspected_locators: Sections s1-s2 and s2-s3: opacity/transparency and hierarchy

sources.title: From many to (n)one: Meditation and the plasticity of the predictive mind
sources.summary: Proposes reduced temporal/conceptual depth in meditation, discussing a radical nondual endpoint and distinctions among traditions.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Theory/review rather than empirical proof of an endpoint. Predictive switching is not that endpoint or an agreed definition of emptiness; a winning model can still be reified.
inspected_locators: Discussion and future directions, printed pp. 212-214

sources.title: Ten simple rules for the computational modeling of behavioral data
sources.summary: Parameter recovery depends on the parameter regime; model recovery uses confusion matrices, and relative comparison needs checks of generated behavior and absolute adequacy.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Software replay and exact finite evidence do not establish human parameter identification, empirical model recovery or philosophical validity.
inspected_locators: Section s8 and s8-4: model recovery and candidate-set limitation

sources.title: Eye Movements During Perception of Complex Objects
inspected_locators: Chapter title, abstract, pp. 171-211 and DOI metadata
sources.summary: The complex-objects chapter identifies the historical scene-viewing lineage; chapter identity differs from the stationary-object chapter linked in the gratitude preprint bibliography.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Full chapter subscription restricted and not read; no detailed original experimental finding inferred from metadata. Castelhano et al. provide separately inspected task-instruction evidence.

sources.title: Viewing task influences eye movement control during active scene perception
sources.role: Empirical task-directed scene viewing and metric distinctions
inspected_locators: Results and General discussion, printed pp. 5-12
sources.summary: Twenty participants viewed natural scenes under search and memorization instructions. Task affected region selection and aggregate fixation measures, while individual fixation durations and average saccade amplitude did not show the same effects.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Task-instruction experiment, not gratitude or contemplative practice. Full article acquired and targeted sections inspected; participant data and supplementary analyses not reanalyzed.

sources.title: The Scream, NG.M.00939
sources.role: Painting identity and licensed reproduction provenance
inspected_locators: Commons original-file photographer, license, checksum and pixel dimensions
sources.summary: The museum identifies Munch's 1893 painting NG.M.00939. The acquired photographic reproduction credits Nasjonalmuseet/Borre Hostland and is supplied under CC BY 4.0.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Image provenance, not scholarly evidence for regional valence or measured gaze. Full-frame registration and overlays are project additions; painting pixels are not inference inputs.

sources.title: Exact and Approximate Stepdown Methods for Multiple Hypothesis Testing
sources.role: Joint-bootstrap lineage and conditions for centered maxima
inspected_locators: Published author PDF: introduction and section 4.2, pp. 102-103; Assumptions B1-B2, Theorems 6-7, Remarks 4-8
sources.summary: Centered joint bootstrap maxima require joint consistency and a suitable nondegenerate limiting law. Studentization and stepdown are distinct choices.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted published-PDF reading; the project implements a single-step original-SE-standardized rectangle, not Romano-Wolf stepdown or a finite-sample coverage theorem.

sources.title: Simultaneous Inference in General Parametric Models
sources.role: Joint covariance, positive variances and common critical values
sources.summary: Simultaneous confidence regions use joint covariance and positive marginal variances; a common critical value differs from pointwise inference.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Author technical report inspected; journal identity verified but final journal layout not read. An inconsistent confidence-level display in report section 3.2 is not imported.

sources.title: Common neural code for reward and information value
sources.role: Instrumental and anticipatory alternatives to a fixed information bonus
inspected_locators: Author laboratory article PDF, pp. 2-3 Results; pp. 5-6 Discussion and behavioral methods
sources.summary: An actionable-lottery model comparison separates instrumental value, fixed or entropy bonuses and anticipatory utility. The combined account improves prediction in that task, while other settings may support other motives.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted article reading; supplement and raw data not inspected. This task does not identify gratitude, the project's information coefficient, a neural implementation or an emptiness mechanism.

sources.title: Induction and Relief of Curiosity Elicit Parietal and Frontal Activity
sources.role: Costly noninstrumental information demand and its measurement boundary
inspected_locators: PMC article: Participants, behavioral Procedures/Analysis Experiments 1-2, Behavioral Results 1-3, Discussion on outcome uncertainty
sources.summary: Participants could wait an additional 3-6 seconds to learn an outcome without changing payout. The uncertainty predictor multiplies entropy by payoff difference, rather than measuring pure entropy.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted full-text sections, not raw-data reanalysis. Waiting, curiosity and this outcome-uncertainty predictor do not identify gratitude, candidate information gain or realization.

sources.title: Gratitude: A Tool for Reducing Economic Impatience
sources.role: Patience as an action bridge and a rival explanation for inquiry
inspected_locators: Harvard author accepted manuscript, pp. 7-12: Method, manipulation checks, temporal discounting and Discussion
sources.summary: Seventy-five young adults received gratitude, happiness or neutral recall before incentivized intertemporal choices. The planned gratitude-versus-pooled-comparators contrast favored patience.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Accepted manuscript and journal metadata inspected; supplement/data not reanalyzed. No claim for every pairwise contrast, durable adherence or gratitude-to-realization mediation.

sources.title: Metamemory: A Theoretical Framework and New Findings
sources.role: Separate metalevel monitoring from control of object-level processing
inspected_locators: Institutional author scan, printed pp. 125-130, principles 1-3, Figure 1, monitoring, control and introspection
sources.summary: A meta-level models object-level processes; monitoring informs that model, while control changes processing. Introspection is fallible data to explain.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Targeted theoretical framework, not a reproduction of its memory experiments. The inspected title page supplies both authors and volume 26, which current Crossref metadata incompletely records. A flat joint scene/encoding model is not the complete architecture.

sources.title: How to measure metacognition
sources.role: Distinguish confidence, metacognitive sensitivity and efficiency
inspected_locators: Introduction and Figure 1, confidence-accuracy table, ROC, efficiency, bias and probability-judgment sections
sources.summary: Confidence level, discrimination of correct versus incorrect decisions and efficiency conditional on first-order performance are distinct measurement targets.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Methodological review used for its authors' measurement framework, not new intervention evidence. A synthetic posterior entropy/Brier loss is not measured human metacognitive sensitivity or efficiency; no raw human data or meta-d-prime fitting was performed.

sources.title: Eye guidance in natural vision: Reinterpreting salience
sources.summary: A review and theoretical synthesis argues that gaze guidance must reflect behavioral relevance, learning and changing information needs, rather than static image salience alone.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Not a gratitude experiment or validation of the authored scene policy. Low-level salience is not claimed to be irrelevant. Targeted introduction, salience evaluation and conclusions inspected.

sources.title: You think you know where you looked? You better look again
sources.summary: Retrospective own-fixation reports offered little advantage over guesses about another observer in the inspected image-viewing tasks. Looking and knowledge of where one looked require separate measurements.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Small, task-specific retrospective-report experiments do not establish absence of online monitoring or effects of deliberate training. The second own/other contrast was marginal, not a robust privileged-access effect. No meditation or gratitude manipulation.

sources.title: Investigating the phenomenological matrix of mindfulness-related practices from a neurocognitive perspective
sources.role: meta-awareness and dereification as distinct constructs
sources.summary: A heuristic phenomenological matrix distinguishes object orientation, dereification and meta-awareness. Heightened meta-awareness can occur without dereification, strengthening the separation of noticing a construction from changing how it is held.
sources.evidence_ceiling: The framework and practice placements are provisional. Proposed dimensions are not a validated common scale or a statistical-independence result. No gratitude efficacy or sufficiency criterion for realizing emptiness follows.

sources.title: Mind the Hype: A Critical Evaluation and Prescriptive Agenda for Research on Mindfulness and Meditation
sources.summary: A critical methodological synthesis recommends specifying instructions, constructs and measures, discussing changing questionnaire interpretations, demand characteristics and the grouping of distinct practices.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A critical synthesis, not evidence that all practices are ineffective or all reports invalid. Reported experience, chosen inquiry and independent performance should be triangulated without treating any one as a realization scale. Issue year is 2018; online-first year is 2017.
inspected_locators: II.B-II.C: semantic ambiguity and integrative assessment
III.A: construct validity and self-report recommendations

sources.title: What Is Meant by “Missing at Random”?
sources.summary: Clarifies realized and everywhere missing-at-random conditions and how assumptions about the observation mechanism, parameters and priors relate to specific likelihood and Bayesian inference targets.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Missing at random does not mean zero information. The article does not validate this project's no-update sentinel or authorize ignoring arbitrary recording failure.

sources.title: The Functional Theory of Counterfactual Thinking
sources.role: counterfactual evaluation, affect and action pathways
sources.summary: A functional framework distinguishes content-specific action information from content-neutral affect, motivation and processing pathways, including contrast with and assimilation toward an alternative.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Theoretical synthesis, not validation of the project's utility equation as a human affect measure. Avoided harm, relief and gratitude remain separate constructs.

sources.title: Identifying the Object of Negation and the Status of Conventional Truth: Why the dGag Bya Matters So Much to Tibetan Mādhyamikas
sources.role: object of negation, conventional efficacy and interpretive differences
sources.summary: Distinguishes intrinsic nature from conventional phenomena, rejects reifying emptiness as another intrinsic nature, and compares Tsongkhapa and Gorampa without adjudicating their disagreement.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Philosophical analysis does not establish that model flexibility or conventional correction constitutes realization. The inspected print title page is dated 2011; the publisher and Crossref record the online date 2010-12-24. Pages 73-87 refer to the inspected print edition.

sources.title: Kataññu Suttas: Gratitude (AN 2.31–32)
inspected_locators: AN 2.31–32 in this edition; PTS A i 61; II,iv,1–2; both translated passages and copyright/citation footer
sources.summary: Gratitude and repayment are connected to benefactors and ethical cultivation.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Translated scripture; neither a benefactor-free appreciation measure nor evidence for gratitude causing realization.

sources.title: Alagaddupama Sutta: The Water-Snake Simile (MN 22)
inspected_locators: MN 22; The Water-Snake Simile and The Raft Simile; translator introduction; title/footer
sources.summary: The raft is used to cross before it is relinquished; studying doctrine also requires understanding its purpose.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Liberation-oriented textual analogy, not a model-selection rule. Translator introduction is interpretation, distinct from the discourse.

sources.title: Suñña Sutta: Empty (SN 35.85)

sources.summary: The discourse applies emptiness of self or what pertains to self across sensory and mental domains.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Named translation, without Pali collation; not identical to absent events, missing data or all later Madhyamaka interpretations.

sources.title: The Tao Teh King, or the Tao and its Characteristics

sources.summary: Chapter 11 uses constructed objects and their unfilled spaces to explain usefulness.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Legge English digital edition; no Chinese manuscript collation, gratitude mechanism or Buddhist equivalence.

sources.summary: Chan distinguishes interpretations of wu and explains wuwei within practical and political contexts.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Scholarly interpretation; not a consensus translation, empirical causal finding or identification of wu with Buddhist emptiness.

sources.role: providential gratitude for perceptual and interpretive capacities as a contrast

Chapter context through printed p. 23 in OCR; no complete-book reading
